subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and providers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `gateway.readiness`, the operator-scoped `ready` RPC, and `registerReadinessCriterion` as permanent public contracts in this release line?
rationale: The code and runtime proof establish technical viability, but automation cannot decide whether these new configuration identities and Plugin SDK APIs are the permanent product boundary maintainers want to support.

options.title: Sponsor the full contract
options.body: Approve the proposed opt-in configuration, canonical projections, and plugin criterion API, then land after the changelog edit is removed and the branch is rebased cleanly.

options.title: Narrow the first phase
options.body: Land canonical built-in readiness and the CLI/RPC projection while deferring plugin-contributed criteria and public selector configuration to the RFC follow-up.

options.title: Pause for RFC resolution
options.body: Keep the implementation draft until the related readiness RFC explicitly settles condition identities, plugin ownership, and compatibility commitments.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full contract
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed opt-in configuration, canonical projections, and plugin criterion API, then land after the changelog edit is removed and the branch is rebased cleanly.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both the existing Gateway readiness path and the plugin registry/API boundary that requires the product decision.
